messages.text: we need to acquire or make real tape deck noises and button noises

Real deck noises are a great call — but since the app is a single file, we can't ship sample files with it. I've recorded the decision and the approach in the plan: synthesize layered mechanical sounds in-app (button thunk, tape hiss while playing, FF/REW whir, stop clunk) so every sound is real and generated live, with an option later to load actual deck samples you add yourself. Next step is building the sound engine into the player.
